service.description: Start sharing the current user's location, the owner, until thruDate (after now, at most location@max-share-hours from now), exact or approximate (precisionEnumId LspExact, the default, or LspApproximate), with a trail kept only when keepTrail is true (for trailKeepDays after the share ends, at most and by default location@trail-max-days). audienceList holds at least one entry, each {audienceTypeEnumId, userId, userGroupId, jid}: LsaUser a user the owner may message (the chat directory's rule, ChatServices.get#RefusedUsers with blocks; a user it refuses answers as one that does not exist), LsaUserGroup a group the owner is in now (never ALL_USERS or a group of external users), read by the members it has now (a snapshot, less every one the chat directory refuses the owner at this act: its hooks, the external-caller rule and blocks) while their membership row stays current, LsaXmpp a contact of the owner's XMPP roster (username@xmpp-server@domain, XmppServices.get#Roster, a user of this server; its positions go to that user's XMPP sessions, and it is told by the LocationSharedXmpp notification), LsaLink a guest link (one a share), whose token is returned here once and kept only as its digest. Each audience user is told who shares with them and until when (the LocationShared notification). At most location@max-active-shares active shares an owner and location@max-audience people (the members its groups reach, counted each), contacts and links a share; a group with more than four times location@max-audience current membership rows is refused before its members are written. Refused with a reasonCode: BAD_UNTIL, TOO_LONG, BAD_PRECISION, BAD_TRAIL_DAYS, AUDIENCE_EMPTY, BAD_AUDIENCE, USER_NOT_FOUND, GROUP_NOT_ALLOWED, XMPP_OFF, XMPP_NOT_CONTACT, ONE_LINK, AUDIENCE_TOO_LARGE, TOO_MANY_SHARES, GROUP_CHECK_FAILED, SHARE_LOCK_FAILED (the owner's lock row could not be made or locked). The share is sent from the device whose key signed this request in (userLoginKeyId, ec.user.loginKeyId: the Android app's), or from no device (a browser page, which sends while it is open); a share with a device takes that device's reports only, and one with none takes no device's (plans/Location-Sharing.md §3.4). takeXmppLocation true lets the owner's XMPP app's location (report#XmppPosition) feed it too, to its XMPP contacts only (§3.6).

parameter.name: takeXmppLocation
parameter.description: Also use the owner's XMPP app's location, sent to the share's XMPP contacts only (plans/Location-Sharing.md §3.6)

parameter.name: linkToken
parameter.description: The guest link's token, returned this once: its selector, a dot and its secret

parameter.name: linkPath
parameter.description: The guest page's link, returned this once: /location/selector#secret, the secret in the fragment only (plans/Location-Sharing.md §3.7); the caller puts its site root before it

service.description: Change an active share of the current user's own: extend or shorten it (thruDate, after now and at most location@max-share-hours from now: extending is the owner's act again), add to its audience (addAudienceList, entries as create#Share's; one already there is passed over, but a group already there is stamped again, in the audit log, with a new snapshot of its members, which lets in those who joined since), and change its label or purpose (a share for a record, store#ShareRecord, is extended no later than the record's end: AFTER_RECORD_END); with sendFromHere true it is sent from this request's device from now on (the app's Send from this device), or from no device (a browser's Send from here), and the device that sent it is refused as another's (409 OTHER_DEVICE), which stops it. The owner's other devices and the audience are told on locationShare:shareId, each user the share newly reaches gets the LocationShared notification, and addedUserList (and the owner's push) names them; a link added returns its token once; an XMPP contact it newly reaches gets LocationSharedXmpp. takeXmppLocation true or false turns the owner's XMPP app's location for it on or off (to its XMPP contacts only); turned on, it raises audienceVersion. Refused: SHARE_NOT_FOUND (not the caller's), SHARE_ENDED, and create#Share's reasons.

parameter.name: takeXmppLocation
parameter.description: true or false: the owner's XMPP app's location fed to the share's XMPP contacts or not; empty leaves it as it is

parameter.name: addedUserList
parameter.description: The users the change lets in, each {userId, userName}

service.description: Stop a share of the current user's own at once: its latest position is deleted, its audience and the owner's other devices are told on locationShare:shareId, and a device still sending gets 410. A kept trail stays for its trailKeepDays, or until delete#Trail. A share already ended is left as it is. Refused: SHARE_NOT_FOUND (not the caller's).

Take one entry of a share of the current user's own out of its audience (a person, a group, an XMPP contact or the link): it reads nothing from now on, and its users are told on locationShare:shareId. Refused: SHARE_NOT_FOUND (not the caller's), AUDIENCE_NOT_FOUND.

A position of an active share, from its owner only: latitude and longitude (degrees, in range), accuracy (metres, optional), heading (degrees from north) and speed (metres a second), observedDate (when the device took it: not before the share began, later than the latest one; now when not given). At most one a location@min-interval-seconds a share (location@approximate-interval-seconds for an approximate one): a sooner one is dropped with statusCode 429 (RATE_LIMITED, retryAfterSeconds). An approximate share's position is the centre of its cell of about 1 km on one fixed grid, the last cell kept until a fix is more than a quarter of a cell inside another (which stops jitter flipping cells; a change of cell still shows a line crossed 0.75 cell from the old centre, within what the person moves in an interval), an accuracy of 1000 or the device's rounded up to the next 1000, no heading or speed, made here before it is stored or sent; its stored and answered observedDate is rounded down to the minute, though the push goes out when the report comes. It replaces the share's LocationLatest, adds a trail point when the share keeps a trail, and is sent on locationShare:shareId to the audience's current users. statusCode 200; 410 (SHARE_ENDED) for a share ended or stopped, which stops the device; 404 (SHARE_NOT_FOUND) for one that is not the caller's; 409 OTHER_DEVICE when this request is not from the device the share is sent from (another device key, or none: a browser), or is from a device while the share is sent from a browser page, which stops it (update#Share sendFromHere moves it); 400 for a value out of range (BAD_POSITION, BAD_ACCURACY, BAD_HEADING, BAD_SPEED) or a time before the share began (BEFORE_SHARE); 409 for one not later than the latest (STALE) or more than a minute ahead of the server's clock (CLOCK_AHEAD, the device's clock is ahead). A refusal names no value.

parameter.name: audienceVersion
parameter.description: The audience version the device's person confirmed: required for a share sent from a device, which refuses another or none with 409 AUDIENCE_CHANGED before anything is written or pushed

service.description: A user location publish (XEP-0080) from the current user's own XMPP client, which the XMPP server (moqui-xmpp session/geoloc.rs) calls with the fields it read and checked (plans/Location-Sharing.md §3.6, LL5): taken by each of the user's active shares whose owner turned on takeXmppLocation (create#Share, update#Share) and that has an XMPP contact in its audience (an LsaXmpp entry not revoked), whatever it is sent from. Such a position goes to the share's XMPP contacts only: kept as its LocationXmppLatest, never as its LocationLatest or trail, never pushed to its users, groups, link or the owner's web. The share's rules hold against that XMPP latest: the rate, the values, staleness, approximate rounding. The first one a share takes tells the owner's XMPP sessions (a headline: whom with, until when). A time more than a minute ahead is taken as now, as a browser page does. No such share: statusCode 403, NO_XMPP_SHARE, so a client's setting never starts a share or feeds one the owner did not choose. Else the best outcome of the shares: 200, else 429 (RATE_LIMITED, retryAfterSeconds), else 409 STALE, else the first refusal (400 BAD_POSITION, BAD_ACCURACY, BEFORE_SHARE; 410 SHARE_ENDED or 404 SHARE_NOT_FOUND for a share that ended or went meanwhile). The session answers 200, 429 and STALE as taken (nothing new kept for the last two), 400 bad-request, and NO_XMPP_SHARE, 410 and 404 not-allowed. A refusal names no value, and adds no error.

parameter.name: observedMillis
parameter.description: XEP-0080's timestamp, epoch milliseconds; now when not given

service.description: An active share of the current user's own as the Android app confirms it in its own dialog and names it in its notification before it sends it from the phone (plans/Location-Sharing.md §3.4): share {shareId, thruDate (epoch millis), untilText (the end in the caller's zone, with the weekday when not today), approximate, intervalSeconds (the share's report interval), audienceText (whom with, in words the owner can check: names with usernames, a group with its member count, anyone with the guest link), audienceVersion (what the device sends with its reports once the person confirmed these words), fromThisDevice (this request's device key is the one it is sent from)}. The words are the server's, never a page's. Refused: SHARE_NOT_FOUND (not the caller's), SHARE_ENDED.

A device key revoked (its owner's sign-out, or the device signed out from the device list; called by the framework with the key's stored hash, user/login.rs): every active share sent from it (LocationShare.userLoginKeyId) is stopped as stop#Share does, its audience told, so none stays on with nothing sending it, also when the device could not tell the server (plans/Location-Sharing.md §3.4). In a transaction of its own (force-new), each share in one of its own too, so nothing here touches the revoke's: a share not of the key's user is refused by name and left, and the rest go on. Called also when an administrator ends a user's keys (Identity.js endCredential).

parameter.name: ownerUserId
parameter.description: The key's user, as the revoke knows it: the key's row, which the revoke writes, is never read here

service.description: The current user's own shares: the active ones, and with includeEnded those ended too (for their kept trails), the newest first, at most 200. Each with its audience (every entry, revoked ones marked: a person's or group's name, a JID, and for the link only that there is one and when it was last viewed, never its token or digest), its end, its latest position while it is active, its trail's size, and where it is sent from (sentFromDevice, the device's deviceName, and fromThisDevice when this request's device key is it; never the key's id).

The active shares of other people whose current audience holds the current user (as a user whose entry is not revoked, or as a member of a group whose entry is not revoked, held in that entry's snapshot by a membership row that is still current), soonest to end first, at most 200: the owner's name, the label and purpose, the end, whether it is approximate, and the latest position with its age. The audience is checked at this read, so a person taken out of a group sees nothing of it.

One share for its owner (with its audience as find#MyShares has it), or for a member of its current audience while it is active: the share, its latest position (while active) and, when it keeps a trail, a page of the trail in time order (trailPageIndex, trailPageSize up to 1000) with its count. A share that is not the caller's and whose current audience does not hold the caller, or that has ended for a viewer, answers SHARE_NOT_FOUND.

Internal, for Chat's live location card (plans/Location-Sharing.md §3.5; ChatLocation.js): whether the share shareId of ownerUserId (the author of the message that carries it) is active now, and that it exists; nothing else of it, no audience or position. A share of another owner answers found false. The caller (Chat) has checked that the current user reads the message; get#Share stays the only read of a share's position.

Internal, for Chat's live location (plans/Location-Sharing.md §3.5): userId's own entry (LsaUser) taken out of each active share of shareList [{shareId, ownerUserId}] (the share of that owner only), as revoke#Audience takes one out (its users and the owner told on locationShare:shareId), whoever the caller is: Chat calls it when a member is taken out of a room by another (remove#Member) or blocked by a share's owner (ChatBlocks.js), for that room's live shares (moqui.chat.ChatLiveShare). It only narrows who sees a share, never the owner's own. In a transaction of its own, each share in one of its own: one that fails is logged by its id and the rest go on. Out: revokedCount.

Delete the whole kept trail of a share of the current user's own, now, whether the share is active or ended; an active share goes on keeping the positions it gets from now on. Refused: SHARE_NOT_FOUND.

The framework's shell-indicator provider, for every signed-in user (MoquiDefaultConf.xml screen-facade shell-providers; plans/Location-Sharing.md §3.3): while the current user has any active share of their own, one indicator, "Sharing location" (with the count when more than one), to Maps › My location shares (MyShares.xml, which every signed-in user opens), asked again at the soonest end (refreshInSeconds) and on the user's own pushes of a share's start, change or end (refreshOn); none otherwise. It counts the user's own shares and reads no audience or position.

The hourly job (clean_LocationShares_hourly): ends the shares past their thruDate, oldest first (endedDate set, the latest position deleted, the audience told), deletes the trail points of each ended share whose trailPurgeDate has come (its end and trailKeepDays, at most location@trail-max-days), and removes the shares ended more than location@trail-max-days ago with no trail left, with their audience (the audit log keeps who shared with whom and when). Each share is on its own, in its own transaction: one that fails is logged by its id and the rest go on. Each stage takes batches until one comes back short, for at most two minutes a run. Out: endedCount, trailDeletedCount (points), removedCount, failedCount.

The token check of the /location/<selector> route: valid when the selector (the route's token, the first part of a guest link's token) names a guest link that is there, whether its share is on or not, so that the page can say it has ended. routeContext is empty: nothing of the share is read for the route. A selector that names no link is refused, which the route counts against the client.

The guest page's read of a share by its link, with no sign-in: linkKey (the selector, the page's path) and linkSecret (the fragment the page posts). Answers statusCode 200 with share {label, purposeText, approximate}, latest {latitude, longitude, accuracy, ageSeconds} (none before a position the server received after the link was added; an approximate share's is its cell, as stored) and map (the outline, or the one basemap the installation marks public: MapLayer isPublic), and nothing else; 404 LINK_NOT_FOUND for a selector that names no link or a wrong secret (counted on the link, failedTries, and against the client); 403 LINK_LOCKED from location@link-max-failed-tries wrong secrets on; 410 SHARE_ENDED once the share has ended or the link was taken out; 429 RATE_LIMITED (retryAfterSeconds) past location@link-max-views-per-minute reads of the link in a minute. A refusal adds no error, so its counts are kept, and names no value.

The record a guest share is for, as MapAdapter names records (recordAdapterKey, recordKey), on an active or ended share of the caller's own. Only for a service that has checked the caller may act on that record (Mantle's mantle.other.LocationShareServices.create#RecordGuestShare), which calls it with authorization off: no group is granted it. The record's end (recordThruDate) is kept on the share: its end is no later, now and when update#Share extends it. Refused: SHARE_NOT_FOUND (not the caller's), BAD_RECORD, AFTER_RECORD_END.

parameter.name: recordThruDate
parameter.description: The record's end (its planned end): the share ends no later, and update#Share refuses an extension past it (AFTER_RECORD_END)

service.description: A record completed or cancelled (Mantle's EECA, plans/Location-Sharing.md §3.7): every share still on for it (recordAdapterKey, recordKey) is stopped as stop#Share does, its audience told, each in a transaction of its own (one that fails is logged by its id and the rest go on), whoever's it is. No group is granted it: only the framework and a component's own services call it. Out: stoppedCount.
